meta.title: feat(geo): add Grok, DeepSeek and Meta AI as swap-only engines (CLEO-138)

notes.body:
## OmniForge

**Verdict:** REQUEST_CHANGES

### Overview

Adds three new swap-only GEO engines (Grok, DeepSeek, Meta AI) following the existing `bing_aio` pattern, plus a refactor unifying the engine-gating logic across 10 call sites. The code itself is careful and well-executed — the refactor is genuinely complete, credentials are handled cleanly, and the "flags ship OFF" safety claim holds. The concerns below are about verification and process, not exploitable security issues: the green pipeline doesn't actually exercise this MR's changed code or tests, the stated test count is overstated, and Meta AI's documented US-only restriction isn't enforced in code — only by remembering not to flip the flag for the wrong reason.

### At a Glance

| | Count |
|---|---|
| Critical | 1 |
| Important | 3 |
| Minor | 2 |

### Strengths
- The `_bing_aio_selectable()` → `_flag_gated_engine_types()` refactor is genuinely complete across all 10 original call sites, verified with no gaps.
- Rollout sequencing is safe by design: engines seed as `status='active'` but every path is flag-gated OFF by default, avoiding a DB-ahead-of-runner window.
- Credential handling is clean — all three new API keys sourced via env vars, never hardcoded or logged; citation rendering inherits existing XSS/SSRF-safe handling.

### Key Concerns
- **Critical:** No CI job actually runs `test_geo_new_engines.py` or `test_engine_slots.py` — the claimed "928 passed, 13 failed" is an unverified local/manual run, not something CI confirms.
- **Important:** The description's "30 tests" claim is overstated (actual: 24) — a second data point that the description's verification claims need double-checking.
- **Important:** Meta AI's US-only restriction is documented but not code-enforced — see inline thread for detail.

### Security
No exploitable vulnerabilities found — access control, credentials, injection, and XSS/SSRF all check out clean. One low-severity note (Meta AI regional enforcement, folded into the Important findings above) is a business/compliance gap, not a security vulnerability.

---
*Reviewed by 3 parallel agents (MR Analyst, Codebase Reviewer, Security Reviewer)*
*Confidence threshold: 70/100 | 6 findings above threshold*

**Important** — Meta AI's US-only restriction is enforced by discipline, not code

**What:** The design doc says Meta AI's flag stays off because the Meta Model API is a "US-only public preview" and offering it to EU/APAC sites "would produce failed runs." But `compute_eligible_engine_types()` never takes a `country` parameter — `GEO_META_AI_SELECTABLE` is a single global boolean, even though `geo_site_config.country` already exists and is used elsewhere (`geo_runner/core/eligibility.py`) for cohort routing.

**Why it matters:** The moment this flag flips — which the doc frames as "the only step to go live" — every site on every plan tier globally becomes eligible to swap in Meta AI, including exactly the EU/APAC sites the doc warns will fail. The safety is currently "remember not to flip it wrong," not enforced anywhere in code.

**Recommendation:**
```python
# Add a country check alongside the flag, e.g. in compute_eligible_engine_types
# or validate_engine_swap, gated on geo_site_config.country for meta_ai specifically.
```
Alternatively, if regional restriction is intended to stay a process control, update the code comment on `GEO_META_AI_SELECTABLE` to say so explicitly — the current comment implies more safety than exists.

Confidence: 90/100 | Found by: Codebase Reviewer (important), Security Reviewer (minor, corroborating) — cross-correlated, kept at higher severity

mentioned in commit 31ac42b1999e46071fd2bd78bf13edc3f6df93d4

### New env required in staging

```
DEEPSEEK_API_KEY      DeepSeek (Anthropic-compatible endpoint)
XAI_API_KEY           Grok / xAI
```

Optional overrides (defaults in code, only set to deviate): XAI_GEO_MODEL default grok-4.3 XAI_API_BASE_URL default https://api.x.ai/v1 DEEPSEEK_GEO_MODEL default deepseek-v4-pro DEEPSEEK_ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL default https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic GEO_RESPONSES_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS default 2000

Feature flags — both default False, flip to enable: FEATURE_GEO_DEEPSEEK_SELECTABLE=true FEATURE_GEO_GROK_SELECTABLE=true

Also needs `deepseek` and `grok` entries in the /geo/ratelimits SSM parameter, or the runner falls back to conservative code defaults. Runner image must be redeployed to pick up the engine changes.
